header:
**$300 a month** from age 22.
When are you a millionaire?
footer: 7% a year, compounded monthly · not a forecast
notes: Stress variant: silent (captions off), 11 rows, long column labels, default pacing (rowsT/rowEvery, no per-row times; row 1 at 0.8 s so frame 1 shows the hero already counting), a goal finish line and a hero icon. Maths: $300 at each month-end from age 22, 7%/12 a month, compounded monthly. Worth after n months = 300 × ((1 + 0.07/12)^n − 1) ÷ (0.07/12), n = 12 × (age − 22). Age 23: $3,717.78; 27: $21,477.87; 32: $51,925.44; 37: $95,088.69; 42: $156,278.00; 47: $243,021.51; 52: $365,991.30; 57: $540,316.38; 62: $787,444.02; 65: $982,838.91; 66: $1,057,606.19. Put in = $300 × n. It first passes $1,000,000 in month 519 (age 65.25), so age 66 is the first birthday as a millionaire. Not a forecast; no fees or taxes.
